reviews.review_description: This game is amazing it is one of the best games i have ever played i love the reverse horror element of it and i love the weapons i love all the ways that you can kill the campers and not just that i love the ways of execution i love that you can stomp on them everything about this game is amazing it is genuinely the best i have not had a opinion like this since i played something like blade and sorcery but this game could use a few fixes and more weapon options like maybe like a chainsaw or something or more clothing options like clown outfits or hoodies or something like that but all around it is an amazing game it i wish i could give this more than five stars cuz that is what it deserves but sadly i cannot still it is an amazing game

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for this review! Being mentioned in the same breath as Blade & Sorcery means a lot to us. We’re really glad the reverse horror, the weapons and the executions are clicking with you! We hear you on the fixes and they’re being worked on. A chainsaw and more outfits like clown suits and hoodies are great ideas, and we’ve added them to our list for future updates. Thanks for playing, and happy hunting!

reviews.review_description: This game puts you right in the shoes of your favorite killer, and let's you stalk your pray however you want, follow them around and wait for your prefect moment. Or run around in a fury killing and chasing them down. Me I find both are fun. Great game and well worth your time and money 💰 plus there's a free trial, so there's really no reason not to give it a try.  Happy hunting, you Psychopath 😁 I know I will 👍

developer_response.body: hank you so much! We love hearing that both the slow stalk and the all-out rampage are fun for you, because that’s exactly the freedom we were going for. Thanks for recommending the free trial too. More is on the way, so happy hunting, fellow psychopath! 🔪😁

reviews.review_description:
Another edit: have y'all thought of starting a discord channel for your players to congregate and be able to drop ideas?? Would be really convenient for people to report bugs instead of leaving bad reviews. 

Maybe mod support for everyone to be able to add content them selves as well, then you wouldnt have to work on everything solo. 
Just a thought




 editing my review and boosting it up a bit, because I noticed in your recent update you actually added some cool new features, and improved a few bug fixes. It stills needs some improvements,  but it is definitely getting there. I agree with what the other guy said about adding more weapons and tools to use, like the chainsaw idea,  I was actually just thinking about that while I was at work. And some more clothing and outfits would be cool, masks, accessories ect. And you guys gotta fix the long hair it looks funny lol. But all in all, great game

developer_response.body: Thanks so much for coming back and updating your review! We’re glad the new features and fixes made a difference, and we’re going to keep improving the game. A chainsaw, more outfits, masks and accessories are all on our list, and we’ve noted the long hair too. It does look a bit funny and we’ll get it sorted. Thanks for sticking with us!

reviews.review_description: I am addicted I love how there are so many different ways you can start the campaign and it's easy to get a hold off and that you can make your own killer great game also I think k you should add the boat or a whole city like in the 8th Friday the 13th

developer_response.body: Thank you, glad you’re hooked! 🔪 Making your own killer and picking how your campaign starts are some of our favourite parts too. A boat or a whole city to hunt through is a great idea, though a full city might be too much for the Meta Quest to handle. We’ve noted it!

reviews.review_description:
This is the most brutal game on quest ever!!
Suggestion:really hope the npc look like in the trailer and add more gore more levels and fix where you auto crouch when I tried to equip the opposite holster it fling me around and auto crouch it's pretty annoying hope you guys can fix it

reviews.review_description: Awesome game I just love the executions. The huge choice of weapons and everything. The only "issue" is that we should have the ability to have more camper in freeway. Other than that 10/10!!!!!

developer_response.body: Thanks so much for the 5 stars! Really glad you’re loving the executions and the weapons. I’m assuming you’re talking about the Freeway map, and yes, we’ll be adding more campers there.
